helix: phase_k(t) = k/K + omega*(t - t0) turns, omega = 0.25 per year

interpolation_error.method: leave-one-out on interior slices, L1 distance on shares

normalization: raw paper count divided by the slice total

projection.method: additive log-ratio transform, per-component linear trend by least squares, leverage-adjusted residual bootstrap scaled by sqrt(n/(n-2)) with refit, inverse transform to the simplex; bands are componentwise quantiles of on-simplex sample paths
